description: This file contains shape inference functions for various tensor operations in the PyTorch lazy tensor core, including shape computations for tensor transformations, layer norms, pooling, and other operations. It accompanies a handwritten header and includes multiple shape calculation implementations specific to the PyTorch lazy evaluation framework.
